# QR code renderer

`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from the MIT-licensed `qrcode-generator@2.0.4` npm package by Kazuhiko Arase.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

SHA-256: `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`

The Google device verification URL is rendered locally. No external QR service receives the URL or activation code. The QR opens the exact verification URL supplied by Google; users enter the separately displayed confirmation code there.
